newsitem.title: USA: Milwaukee $100 mln note deal split by three firms.
newsitem.headline: Milwaukee $100 mln note deal split by three firms.

text.p: Three firms split Milwaukee's $100 million note deal, market sources said Tuesday.
Lehman won a $40 million piece with a coupon of 4.25 percent and true interest cost of 3.62022. The firm also won a $20 million piece with a 4.25 percent coupon and a TIC of 3.63069.
Smith Barney Inc won a $30 million piece with a coupon of 4.25 percent and a TIC of 3.63068.
Morgan Keegan & Co Inc won $10 million with a 4.50 percent coupon and a TIC of 3.63002.
